scope: Preserved v1-v6 branches plus hidden-health/selector-cost v7 gates. Not a systematic literature survey.

state_meanings.validated_scope: executed with declared assumptions, no novelty implied
state_meanings.parked: preserved, only activated by its trigger

branches.title: Causal frame
branches.hypothesis: Fixed initial law, event and deadline across actions
branches.reactivation_trigger: Counterfactual comparison changes its initial equilibrium or failure set
branches.minimal_test: Re-run two-action scan from identical initial state and event
branches.acceptance_gate: A comparison changing only the admitted intervention
branches.novelty_status: unestablished; established theories must be audited before any originality claim

branches.title: Action sufficiency
branches.hypothesis: Zero-error action cover and higher-order compatible contexts
branches.reactivation_trigger: A new task requires a minimal deterministic decision representation
branches.minimal_test: Exhaust finite relation versus all encoder partitions
branches.acceptance_gate: Matching exact code and dual or exhaustive lower certificate
branches.novelty_status: unestablished; established theories must be audited before any originality claim

branches.title: Soft decision information
branches.hypothesis: Average-information distortion rather than fixed code cardinality
branches.reactivation_trigger: Nonzero mistakes or nonuniform context priors are admitted
branches.minimal_test: Binary rate-distortion benchmark versus exact decision value
branches.acceptance_gate: Explicit risk-dependent information bound with policy class fixed
branches.novelty_status: unestablished; established theories must be audited before any originality claim

branches.title: Rare-event epistemic reliability
branches.hypothesis: Information limit and error exponent need separate accounting
branches.reactivation_trigger: Mean accuracy masks catastrophic small-noise effects
branches.minimal_test: Same limiting MI, different error-exponent sensors
branches.acceptance_gate: Failure-rate prediction checked with finite-noise prefactors
branches.novelty_status: unestablished; established theories must be audited before any originality claim

branches.title: Finite-time physical action
branches.hypothesis: Do not substitute quasipotential for a deadline
branches.reactivation_trigger: Physical repair/sensing operation needs a calibrated failure law
branches.minimal_test: OU benchmark, then fixed-frame bistable first passage
branches.acceptance_gate: Controlled finite-time event rate, not just mean escape time
branches.novelty_status: unestablished; established theories must be audited before any originality claim

branches.title: Critical scaling
branches.hypothesis: Normal forms and scaled deadlines near saddle-node
branches.reactivation_trigger: Direct numerical rates fail near a critical parameter
branches.minimal_test: Rescaled quartic versus normal-form action
branches.acceptance_gate: Uniformity scope and independent collapse check

branches.reactivation_trigger: One-dimensional quadrature no longer applies
branches.minimal_test: Two-dimensional controlled diffusion and convergence witness
branches.acceptance_gate: A justified limit or error certificate, not visual agreement

branches.title: Correlated substrate noise

branches.reactivation_trigger: A policy impossibility follows from only examining the diagnostic register

branches.title: Hidden-health stage-dependent finite-memory control

branches.reactivation_trigger: Removing a health flag or other designer-only state from the physical interface
branches.minimal_test: Occupancy over shared (syndrome,budget) prescriptions vs health-visible relaxation
branches.acceptance_gate: Exact restricted policies, explicit clock, no free posterior at execution; independent small-horizon oracle
branches.novelty_status: finite-state control antecedents; no originality claim

branches.title: Deteriorating meta-selector and program library costs
branches.hypothesis: Repair and memory wear may change the actual set of available whole prescriptions
branches.reactivation_trigger: A multi-period control proof assumes the contingent selector is permanently reliable
branches.minimal_test: Two circuit modes with different truth tables, wear, repair and pathwise costs; strict viable-policy gap
branches.acceptance_gate: Constructible policy, lower certificate for implementation and falsification via alternate circuitry
branches.novelty_status: open physical class; compare to FSC/POMDP circuit synthesis

rejected_simplifications.reason: The contingent policy requires both a funded selector and an affordable action; B=3 v7 has perfect diagnosis but zero gain

rejected_simplifications.reason: Health drift attenuates the observation-to-action correlation and crosses a critical decision threshold

rejected_simplifications.claim: A useful diagnostic cannot reduce survival
rejected_simplifications.reason: Even a perfect measurement may carry procedure failure; with zeta >= 0.02817661 in the stated fixture its net value is zero

gate_rules: At most two active branches. Record a reason and evidence before changing state.
If an attempted novelty is an existing theorem, retain it as an instrument; do not relabel it original.
After two scoped models yield no new implication, freeze feature expansion and run an antecedent/ablation audit.
If exact aggregation fails, refine the observable partition or use a quantified approximate contract, never suppress the residual.
If a finite-horizon bound is vacuous, shorten the certified horizon or tighten contracts; do not report it as a safety guarantee.
Every result retains a fixed causal frame, complete information boundary, implementability class, resource law, and failure event.
Every resumed branch specifies a minimal falsifier and is added to the failure ledger if contradicted.
Every diagnostic result must distinguish value of information, budget-feasible value, and health-observed relaxation; never report the last as an implementable controller.
